method: Whole-tree unresolved-reference sweep. Each accepted use has the named COFF operand and signed addend, full current typed payload equal to retail with no pointer relocations or overlapping source owners, and a unique instruction context with a separate known reference anchor. Operand widths/registers/constants agree, local byte maps are injective, internal branches and outgoing directions are checked. These are reference-identity controls, not complete-body matching claims. Host/local game-position conflicts are explicitly withheld.

direct_dataflow_controls.method: The thiscall arguments are town* at EBP+8 and building at EBP+12. Retail loads the signed town faction byte at offset 3, multiplies by the six-byte dwelling row stride, adds building, and loads one signed byte from 0x490601. The verified 4x6 table starts at 0x490608, establishing the exact -7 addend. Both sites use the same expression; surrounding AI arithmetic is not certified.
